key.description: The key of the addon. It should be unique and case sensitive.

name.description: Shown to GMs. Letters, digits, spaces and - ( ) . , : ' &

repositoryUrl.description: The repository URL of the addon. It should be a valid URL.

releaseUrl.description: The release URL of the addon. It should be a valid URL.

dependencies.description: Optional. Addons from the registry this one needs, installed (or updated) before it. Each is { key, version }. Addons can't depend on each other in a circle.

key.description: The key of the dependency. It should match the 'key' field of the required addon. The key is case sensitive.

version.description: Optional. The lowest version of the dependency that works: '0.0.5' and '0.1.0' satisfy '0.0.4'. Leave it out for any version.

categories.description: Optional. Keys of the categories this addon belongs to. Each key should match a 'key' in the repository's 'categories' list.
